prices._note: USD per million tokens, list prices as of 2026-11 (Anthropic pricing page, standard rates; cache read 5% of input, 5 minute write 1.25x, 1 hour write 2x, output 5x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5; Haiku 5.5 writes are 1.25x and 2x input). To update: copy the new rates from the pricing page per model id, add a key for a new model id (a key also matches dated ids that start with it), then re-run usage-ledger.mjs --inject. Models without an entry count 0 USD and are listed in unpricedModels.
